## Projects

- RealCheck (shipped, Chrome Web Store review): Chrome extension that grades product reviews from A to F on Amazon, Flipkart, Walmart, Myntra and more, fully in the browser.
- Treadle (UI concept): product page for a foot pedal that runs AI agents while your foot is down. https://treadle-pedal.vercel.app
- Clypso (building): YouTube video in; summary, key points, quotes, chapters, SEO and social posts out. https://clypso-eta.vercel.app
- RedditMind (building): agent that writes a personalised morning briefing from your subreddits.
- Waystub (planning): trip planner set as a railway timetable.
- Agentic AI Research Assistant: multi-agent deep research in LangGraph with live web search and cited reports.
- Krishi Saahayak: crop disease detection across 38 classes; ensemble of five models reached 99.55% accuracy.
- TalentScout: LLM screening assistant that writes technical questions for each candidate's stack.
